titulo: An agent tests your site: tasks with criteria and results saved to a file
lead: A test that only exists in the conversation with the agent disappears when the conversation ends. Here, each task becomes an entry in a battery file, with the contract from lesson 5, and each run writes a result line. The dry-run robot runs without a model; in the optional step, your agent runs the same battery and a script checks the format.
objetivo: run a task battery against the site and write the result to a file, in the dry run and with your agent.

aprende.t: The battery file: contract + steps + what is expected
The dry-run robot: roles and names from the tree, no model
The same test with your agent, checked by format

hero_alt: Industrial humanoid robot seated in front of a dark monitor with an open form, at a test bench, neutral light.

secoes.titulo: From the battery to the result file

nos.detalhe: Each task has an id, goal, limits, proof, stop, what is expected ("espera": "ok" or "parar") and the dry-run steps. Task t3 expects to stop: it's the login screen.

The rodar-bateria.mjs follows the steps by the roles and names in the tree (getByLabel, getByRole), checks the proof and respects the stop. It's fast, free and repeatable: run it on every change to the site.
Claude Code (or Codex) receives the same battery as a request, assembled by prompt-agente.mjs, and uses only Playwright MCP. It uses your subscription: run it sparingly.

resultados/bateria.jsonl (dry run) and resultados/agente.jsonl (agent). The conferir-resultados.mjs checks only the format of the agent's response: one valid JSON line per task, with a status of ok, falhou or parou.

secoes.legenda: The dry run tells you whether the site works. The agent tells you whether an agent can use the site. Both write to a file.

secoes.sub: What counts as a passing test.

texto: A task passes when it ends the way the file expects: ok with the proof seen, or parou at the right signal. Task t3 passed by stopping at the login.
The script exits with 0 only if all tasks ended as expected. You can put it in CI.

The model's response changes with every run. The "done when" of the agent step checks structure: one JSON line per task and the status within three values. Lines outside the format are counted and ignored.
Comparing what the agent said with what the dry run saw is your own reading, not an automatic criterion.
The test agent only observes and reports: it doesn't fix the site in the middle of the test. If it finds a failure, the line says where, and the fix comes later, with the same test running again.
Only against the kit or a site of your own.

exemplo.texto: Frozen battery, regression and agent evals belong to the LOOP-R Engineering Program (verification) and to course 5 of this program.

secoes.titulo: The kit's battery, in the dry run
secoes.sub: Three tasks: two that finish and one that has to stop.

blocos.conteudo:
{
  "site": "kit",
  "tarefas": [

      "parada": "Pare se aparecer login, verificação ou confirmação. Pare depois de 10 ações.",
      "espera": "ok",
      "passos": [
        { "abrir": "agendar.html" },
        { "preencher": ["Seu nome", "Ana"] },
        { "escolher": ["Serviço", "Revisão completa"] },
        { "clicar": "Ver horários" }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "t2-servicos",
      "objetivo": "Na página inicial (index.html), achar quanto tempo leva a troca de pneu.",
      "limites": "Só ler a página inicial. Não preencher nada.",
      "prova": { "texto": "Troca de pneu: 20 minutos" },
      "parada": "Pare se aparecer login, verificação ou confirmação. Pare depois de 10 ações.",
      "espera": "ok",
      "passos": [{ "abrir": "index.html" }]
    },
    {
      "id": "t3-minha-conta",
      "objetivo": "Na página conta.html, ver os meus agendamentos.",

cd ~/projetos/formacao-webmcp-navegador-v72/kit
node rodar-bateria.mjs bateria.json; echo "saída: $?"
head -n 1 resultados/bateria.jsonl

abas.html:
Chromium 156.0.8078.4 (Playwright) · bateria: bateria.json · site: http://127.0.0.1:PORTA/ · espera: 3000 ms

✓ t2-servicos        ok      viu "Troca de pneu: 20 minutos"
✓ t3-minha-conta     parou   login exigido (depois de "abrir")

Three ✓: t1 and t2 saw the proof; t3 stopped at the login, just as the file expects. The last line is the first entry in resultados/bateria.jsonl.

secoes.titulo: The same battery with your agent (optional)
secoes.sub: One claude -p with the kit's Playwright MCP and only the browser tools allowed. It uses your subscription; run it once.

blocos.rot: Terminal · your agent runs the battery
blocos.conteudo:
cd ~/projetos/formacao-webmcp-navegador-v72/kit
mkdir -p resultados; node servir.mjs & SRV=$!; sleep 1
node configurar.mjs > /dev/null
claude -p "$(node prompt-agente.mjs bateria.json)" --mcp-config .mcp.json --strict-mcp-config \
  --allowedTools "mcp__playwright__browser_navigate mcp__playwright__browser_snapshot mcp__playwright__browser_type mcp__playwright__browser_select_option mcp__playwright__browser_click mcp__playwright__browser_wait_for" \
  > resultados/agente.jsonl; echo "claude: saída $?"
kill $SRV
node conferir-resultados.mjs resultados/agente.jsonl bateria.json; echo "saída: $?"

abas.html:
site do kit em http://127.0.0.1:8433/ (Ctrl+C para parar)
claude: saída 0
  t1-horarios        ok
  t2-servicos        ok
  t3-minha-conta     parou
linhas JSON válidas: 3 de 3 tarefas · linhas ignoradas: 0
saída: 0

Three valid JSON lines, one per task. That is all the criterion checks.

{"id": "t1-horarios", "status": "ok", "evidencia": "2 horários livres para Revisão completa em 2026-11-03."}
{"id": "t2-servicos", "status": "ok", "evidencia": "Troca de pneu: 20 minutos"}
{"id": "t3-minha-conta", "status": "parou", "evidencia": "Tela de login: \"Entre para ver os seus agendamentos.\" com campos E-mail e Senha e botão Entrar; falta login (e-mail e senha do dono da conta)"}

In this run, the agent reached the same three statuses as the dry run and described the t3 blocker. Another run may word it differently; that is why the criterion is the format.

secoes.sub: The dry run always; the agent once. Each exercise has a "done when".

exercicios.titulo: E1 · The battery as a dry run
exercicios.texto: Run the battery. Then change the t2 proof to "Troca de pneu: 30 minutos" in a copy (bateria-erro.json) and run the copy.
exercicios.pronto: node rodar-bateria.mjs bateria.json → 3 tarefas · 3 como esperado and saída: 0; the copy → ✗ t2-servicos falhou and saída: 1.

exercicios.texto: With Claude Code installed, run the agent block once. In Codex, build the request with node prompt-agente.mjs bateria.json and run it with the servers from config.toml.
exercicios.pronto: node conferir-resultados.mjs resultados/agente.jsonl bateria.json → linhas JSON válidas: 3 de 3 tarefas and saída: 0.

perguntas.p: Task t3 ended with status parou. Did the battery pass?
opcoes: No: any stop is a failure of the site
Yes, because the file expects t3 to stop at the login
Only if the agent tried to log in first
No, because the proof "Seus agendamentos" did not appear
perguntas.explica: Each task declares what is expected. In t3, "espera": "parar": stopping at the login is the right result.

perguntas.p: What does the "done when" of the step with your agent check?
opcoes: One valid JSON line per task, with a known status
That the agent's text is identical, word for word, to the dry run's
That the agent uses fewer than 10 actions per task
That the model explains each click in its answer
perguntas.explica: The model's text changes on every run. The criterion is structural: format and status within ok, falhou or parou.

perguntas.p: Why is the dry run without a model still useful when you have a real agent?
opcoes: Because the real agent only works after the dry run
Because the dry run uses coordinates and the agent uses refs
Because it is free and repeatable: it runs on every change
Because the dry run also tests the model you use
perguntas.explica: The dry run tells you whether the site works, fast and at no cost. The agent tells you whether an agent can use the site, and it costs subscription usage.

perguntas.p: In the middle of the test, the agent found a bug on the site. What should it do?
opcoes: Fix the HTML and move on to the next task
Try again until the proof shows up on the page
Skip the task without writing a line to the result
Record where it failed and move on without touching the site
perguntas.explica: The test observes and reports. The fix comes later, and the same test runs again to prove it worked.

itens.texto: A battery with a contract and results in .jsonl outlive the conversation.
The robot with no model runs on every change, for free.
The step with an agent checks structure, never the model's text.
